title: Payroll
description: One run per month: salaries adjusted for work system, minus penalties and lateness, plus or minus one-off adjustments.
runDescription: Draft until approved. Recalculate after changing penalties, lateness or settings.
runDescriptionApproved: Approved {date}. Approved runs never change; corrections go into next month as adjustments.

empty.title: No payroll runs yet
empty.body: Create this month's run to calculate every active employee's salary.

create.title: Create a payroll run
create.body: A draft run is created with a line for every active employee, calculated from today's penalties, lateness and settings.

actions.bankSheetAfterApproval: The bank sheet is available once the run is approved.

rulesChanged.title: HR rules changed since the last calculation
rulesChanged.body: The lateness or payroll rules in Settings changed after this run was calculated. Recalculate to apply them.

approve.title: Approve {month}?
approve.body: Every line is recalculated one last time, then the run, its penalties, lateness and adjustments are locked. An approved run can't be edited.
approve.pendingBody: Pending penalties dated this month: {count}. Approve or cancel them first, then approve the payroll.
approve.staleTitle: Penalties changed since the last calculation
approve.staleBody: Some lines still show pending penalties from the last calculation. Recalculate to update them.

empty.title: No employees in this run
empty.body: Runs include every active employee. Add employees, then recalculate.

noResults.title: No employees match
noResults.body: Try another name, department or filter.

rules.title: Rules applied this month
rules.body: These settings produced every number on this page.
rules.currentBody: This run was calculated on {date}. These are today’s settings and may differ from the ones it used; its numbers don’t change.
rules.workSystemRule: Full-time 100% · 4 days {pt4}% · 3 days {pt3}% · 2 days {pt2}% of basic
rules.penaltiesRule: Approved day deductions × day value; repeats counted per {window}
rules.netFloorRule: Net never goes below 0; such lines need review
rules.error: The HR rules couldn't load. The figures are still the server's.

notApplied.title: Adjustments not applied
notApplied.body: These employees left the run (deactivated before the last recalculate). Their adjustments stay on record but don't count.
notApplied.label: Not applied
notApplied.employee: Not applied — {name} is no longer in this run

adjustments.title: Adjustments · {name}
adjustments.description: One-off additions or deductions for {month}, each with a reason.
adjustments.none: No adjustments for this employee this month.
adjustments.readOnly: The run is approved: adjustments can't change.
adjustments.readOnlyNoPermission: You can view these adjustments. Changing them needs the Adjust payroll permission.

payslip.title: Payslip
payslip.penaltyShareNote: Each penalty's amount is its share of the penalty deduction; the total is what is deducted.
payslip.netFloored: Deductions exceeded the salary, so net pay is 0.

empty.title: No payroll yet
empty.body: This employee's salary appears here once they are in a payroll run.

returned.title: Returned by Accounting on {date}
returned.body: Reason: {reason}. Fix what's needed, then approve the month again.
